title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1988-07-15
source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid = 141922) Recording Info: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90); Transfer Info: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller + AUD (shnid = 137888) NAK-CM100-CP4 Shotguns(2) AT-Shotguns model unknown(2) > Tascam PortaOne 4-Track Cassette w/DBX Type II on > Maxell XLII-S90 - Set up dead center on hill behind seating and walkway on 2 mic stands 10-12' high; XLII-S90 > Onkyo TA-2027 > dbx-224X processer > Carver HR-722 > Sony M-10 (Wave 16 bit/tracked) > Soundforge 9 (fades for tape flipps) > encoded to FLAC (level 8) w/ TLH - matrix mixing by Kevin Tobin

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording balances audience ambience with clear mix, capturing a joyous two‑set night highlighted by a soaring Scarlet > Fire and an inspired Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The matrix source provides enough crowd sound to convey the rapture of the evening while keeping the instruments clean and well‑balanced. The performance is praised throughout – from a jazzy Shakedown Street through a monster Good Times, a 20‑minute Scarlet > Fire, and an exquisite Morning Dew – with Phil’s bass booming in the mix and Brent’s organ adding extra firepower.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic review rates the show 4 stars, highlighting strong musical moments and a good‑quality matrix recording; weighted rating leans toward a high score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Balanced matrix mix with enough audience to feel the atmosphere; Phil is loud in the mix, occasional vocal flubs noted but overall clear and enjoyable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set marathon with a 48‑minute pre‑drums stretch that builds momentum, followed by energetic drumming and post‑space improvisations; the pacing stays engaging from start to encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Dialed‑in on Morning Dew, delivering expressive lead work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Prominent in the mix, delivers multiple bass bomb bursts and drives the post‑space energy.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s Leslie organ shines on Good Times, Gimme Some Lovin' and Morning Dew, adding a rich texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Energetic, weaving thematic patterns that lift the performance.
